blocks.text: ARIA-nominated Australian singer-songwriter Kita Alexander today unveils ‘Back To Sydney’, a brand new bonus track from her #1 ARIA Australian Album RAGE, via Warner Music Australia. Listen HERE. Boasting a blend of acoustic folk and soft pop-rock, ‘Back to Sydney’ is a nostalgia-fuelled anthem that explores whether home is a place, a person, or a feeling. The track pairs intimate, reflective verses with a soaring chorus, capturing the bittersweet pull of returning to the places, people and memories that shape us, all wrapped in an organic sound that feels both deeply personal and instantly relatable.
